'''2010 World Championship''' was the 15th Star Wars CCG World Championship, run by the [[Players Committee]] in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on 12–15 August 2010.<ref name="forum" /><ref name="awards" /> The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]. 61 players took part.<ref name="wp" /> [[Dan Kim]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final, playing Exploiting Opportunities and The Rebel Alliance! on Day 3; it was Krueger's second runner-up finish after 2008.<ref name="awards" /><ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee published the Day 2 and Day 3 lists only; no Day 1 or Team Tournament lists were published.<ref name="decklists">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2010-decklists/ 2010 Decklists], starwarsccg.org</ref>

=== Top 8 bracket ===

A 2020 forum post quoting an earlier player compilation gives this Day 3 bracket (seeds in brackets).<ref name="f75427-1300387" /> It does not name [[Chris Twiss]], whose Light list is in the Day 3 PDF (listed under [[#Other published decklists|Other published decklists]]).

* Quarterfinals: (1) [[Jonny Chu]] def. (8) [[Aaron Kingery]]; (2) [[Kyle Krueger]] def. (7) [[Matt Sokol]]; (3) [[Steve Baroni]] def. (6) [[Chris Terwilliger]]; (5) [[Dan Kim]] def. (4) [[Justin Desai]]
* Semifinals: Dan Kim def. Jonny Chu; Kyle Krueger def. Steve Baroni
* Final: Dan Kim def. Kyle Krueger

Day 3 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2010 Worlds Day 3.pdf]] (pages 11–12 are [[Kyle Krueger]]'s typed Dark and Light lists). [[Chris Twiss]] Light and [[Chris Terwilliger]] Dark are one-side-only in that PDF. Steve Baroni's Dark list (deck name Dry Clean Only) is published; unreadable lines are marked (illegible) on the deck page.
